notes: *As for* is `added` because the fronted `הַלַּיְלָה הַהוּא` carries no object marker and no preposition — rule 16's limit on its third family, on the `וּמַרְאֵיהֶם` precedent.
Every *the* in *the days of the year* and *the number of the months* is supplied: no article morpheme stands in either chain (rule 29).
